model.domain: Euclidean plane minus the obstacle interiors
model.obstacles: three closed radius-r disks at the vertices of an equilateral triangle of side d
model.orientation: oriented rays; time reversal reverses the cyclic word

nonclaims: No target arithmetic local datum, Euler factor, root number, automorphy, divisor, functional equation, or zero match is asserted.
The collision-code zeta is source-local and uses bounce count rather than geometric length.
The exterior Dirichlet Laplacian is only the natural quantization of the billiard geometry, not a Hilbert--Polya operator.
No literary priority is claimed for classical open-billiard coding or dispersing hyperbolicity.

proof_contract.boundary: no-eclipse excludes an interior minimizing vertex
proof_contract.existence: compact minimization of polygonal length over the product of closed disks
proof_contract.finite_role: finite words and optical grids audit conventions only; they do not prove geometric coding
proof_contract.hyperbolicity: positive free-flight and defocusing optical matrices have determinant one and trace greater than two
proof_contract.reflection: the constrained first variation gives specular reflection and excludes grazing
proof_contract.uniqueness: convexity plus strict convexity of every disk excludes two distinct minimizers

theorem_contract.coding: cyclically reduced cyclic classes correspond bijectively to periodic-ray iterates
theorem_contract.geometry: each coded iterate has a unique non-grazing, isolated, dispersing-hyperbolic geometric support
theorem_contract.iterate_convention: a periodic-ray iterate is a primitive oriented geometric ray paired with a positive traversal multiplicity
theorem_contract.primitive_coding: primitive cyclic classes correspond bijectively to primitive oriented geometric rays
theorem_contract.reversal: [w] maps to [reverse(w)] without automatic division by two
